When a configuration changes and its service is inactive, `service.configure` now selects the fixed restart command before considering the profile's reload action. An active service still uses the approved profile action after a change. Exact create versus prior-digest replacement, immutable profile version, restart allowlist, protected units, file custody and closed uncertainty results remain required.

The TypeScript service result accepts the same maximum service name as its request and Go handler: 128 characters before the eight-character `.service` suffix, 136 total. A literal suffix and exact end/option-name refinement reject malformed, newline-terminated and option-shaped names. The added transport model exercises a real longest-name request/result roundtrip and rejects a 129-character prefix. This is modeled transport evidence, not a live guest or systemd claim.

The producer creates only its own private `service-app`, `service-templates` and `service-backups` children. It recaptures the root and child identities before removing those positively owned children.

The producer reads and checks actual target bytes and the actual private intent's purpose, profile, original prior state, desired digest, mode, creation flag and retained state.
